exposure: scheduled gestational age for repeat elective cesarean section (CS)
elective CS at 38 weeks of gestation
elective CS at 39 weeks of gestation
cohort: Singleton pregnant women with a history of cesarean section scheduled for a repeat elective cesarean section
finding: Scheduling a repeat elective cesarean section at 38 weeks of gestation, compared to 39 weeks, significantly reduced the emergency cesarean section rate and maternal intra-operative complications, with no significant differences in maternal post-operative or neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The emergency CS rate in 39 weeks gestation group was significantly higher than 38 weeks group. The incidence of adverse maternal intra-operative complications was statistically different with emergency CS when compared to elective CS in case and control groups.
